apps.name: BetterBMS
apps.subtitle: JBD / CyberCase BLE BMS
apps.localizedDescription:
BetterBMS talks to JBD (Xiaoxiang) BLE BMS boards such as CyberCase. Live telemetry, MOSFET control, EEPROM parameters, and pack-tuned limits for 4S6P Molicel P42A.

Sign and install with Feather using your own certificate.

versions.localizedDescription: Charge-to-full + top-balance: bleed at rest so a plugged-in pack at 0 A can still equalize. Cell OV 4.250 V. No TestFlight — Feather IPA only.
PIN probe 0x80 no longer fake-rejects a good unlock.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Connects to your BMS over Bluetooth Low Energy.

news.title: 1.3.41 — charge to full + balance
news.caption: Must show 1.3.41 in Mine. Plugged-in idle packs now bleed at rest so the charger can finish the low cell.
